title: Per-role model routing config (V25 Task 6)
description: Selects, per pipeline role, which model process route (claude-cli | codex) and model/effort a ModelGateway task should build against. The authoritative validator is validateModelRoutingConfig() in src/runtime/codexRoute.ts; this schema documents the shape. "claude-cli" is not selectable in production until Task 7 ships createClaudeRoute() — selecting it before then throws ClaudeRouteNotAvailableError (fail-closed). Any role/defaultRoute whose model matches /^gpt-5\.5/ must have route:"codex" AND ownerOverride:"D1-gpt-exception-approved" (the NO-GPT-5.5 tripwire). Role keys are closed (research|author|repair|review|qc) and effort tiers are exactly the tiers the claude CLI accepts — both enforced by validateModelRoutingConfig.

ownerOverride.description: Gate for the temporary gpt-5.5-as-author exception (D1). Must equal "D1-gpt-exception-approved" for any gpt-5.5* model to validate.
